response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"source.html, paragraph beginning “Let us look first at Law and Grace”","severity":"major","source_quote":"Someone that is under the law does not desire to do what he must do, but rather, he does it because of the law.","suggested_fix":"Change “tidak ingin melakukan apa yang harus dilakukannya” to “tidak ingin melakukan apa yang harus dilakukannya, tetapi melakukannya karena hukum” only if needed for clarity; the current translation preserves the source meaning.","translation_quote":"Orang yang berada di bawah hukum tidak ingin melakukan apa yang harus dilakukannya, melainkan melakukannya karena hukum."},{"location":"source.html, paragraph beginning “Let us look at grace”","severity":"major","source_quote":"You are not your own and you desire to be all you can be for your Savior who died for you.","suggested_fix":"Replace “Kamu bukan milikmu sendiri” with “Kamu bukan milikmu sendiri” only if retaining the idiom; otherwise, use “Kamu bukan milik dirimu sendiri,” preserving the meaning that the person belongs to another.","translation_quote":"Kamu bukan milikmu sendiri dan ingin melakukan segala yang kamu mampu bagi Juruselamatmu yang telah mati untukmu."},{"location":"source.html, paragraph beginning “A poor criminal who has only known the city streets as home”","severity":"major","source_quote":"God saves him, transforms him, converts him.","suggested_fix":"Replace “membarui dirinya” with “mempertobatkannya” to preserve the distinct assertion that God converts him.","translation_quote":"Allah menyelamatkannya, mengubahnya, dan membarui dirinya."}],"passed":false,"score":94}
